in_marathi.name: Sindhuja
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of River
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sindhuja हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sindhuja is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sindhu' which means 'ocean' or 'river'. This name is given to a girl born near a river or to a girl who is believed to bring peace and tranquility in her surroundings.
